about: D1511 (#3762): the fake AI binding's recorded outputs (cloudflare-worker/test/_fake_ai.mjs). Each recording answers the first call whose model (null: any) and prompt pattern (a RegExp source, multiline) match. Synthetic words only: no figure, no name of a real person or company. The deck build's words name no number, as the composer requires, so none is dropped.

recordings.prompt: ^Write the cards of a pitch deck

cards.headline: The close, done in a day.
cards.body: Synthetic Ledger Co gives finance teams their week back.

cards.headline: Month-end eats the week.
cards.body: Teams told us the close is the job they dread most.

cards.headline: Customers pay and stay.
cards.body: Revenue grows from teams who tried it and kept it.

cards.headline: One ledger that closes itself.
cards.body: Entries reconcile as they land, so the close is a review.

cards.headline: Proof from the people who close.
cards.body: Interviews and signed letters back the claim.

cards.headline: Shipping steadily.
cards.body: Must-haves are done and releases go out on a cadence.

cards.headline: A crowded market, a sharp wedge.
cards.body: We win where the close is the pain.

cards.headline: Efficient by design.
cards.body: Burn is held while revenue climbs.

cards.headline: Operators who lived the problem.
cards.body: The founders ran finance teams before building this.

cards.headline: Raising to scale the close.
cards.body: The round funds product and go to market.

cards.headline: Where the money goes.
cards.body: Most of it builds the product; the rest finds customers.

cards.headline: Who we meet in deals.
cards.body: We are tracked against the incumbents.

cards.headline: Who owns the company.
cards.body: Founders hold the company with an early backer.
